title: Inspect saved rule scan progress in Companion
description: Use a disabled checkpoint-validation rule and its team. The preview shows the gateway's stored progress and observation window without creating work.

open.cmd: if [ "$PLATFORM" = ios ]; then xcrun simctl openurl "$IOS_SIMULATOR" farmslot-development:///pr-automation; else adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d farmslot-development:///pr-automation net.siteed.farmslot.development; fi
open.intent: The operator can inspect source coverage from PR automation on the selected device.

ready.intent: The connected screen exposes shared rule controls.

rules.intent: Rule previews remain available without accepting or starting reviews.

filter.intent: The operator can isolate one team's source progress.

search.intent: The selected validation team can be found in the saved inventory.

keyboard.intent: The filtered team selection remains reachable after completing the search.

choose.intent: Only the selected team's rule controls are displayed.

visible.intent: The rule's preview action is reachable below its team configuration.

preview.intent: The operator resumes saved source discovery without enabling the rule.

progress.intent: The returned provider progress includes its observation window and saved page count.

show.intent: The provider progress and any retry timing can be read together.

capture.intent: The screenshot records the real gateway's saved scan progress.
